document.title: Document
document.description: The content of the document that will be returned to Ask Fern during document retrieval.

chunk.title: Chunk
chunk.description: The textual content that should be vectorized when indexing the document. If not provided, the full document will be vectorized.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title of the document. This will be used with the `url` when Ask Fern cites this document.

url.title: Url
url.description: The url of the document. This will be used as the source of the document when Ask Fern cites it.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version of the document. This will be compared against when running Ask Fern with version filters. If null, the document will be retrievable by all versions.

product.title: Product
product.description: The product of the document. This will be used to filter documents when running Ask Fern with product filters. If null, the document will be retrievable by all products.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: The keywords of the document. Adding keywords can improve document matching.

authed.title: Authed
authed.description: Whether the document is authed. If true, the document will be retrievable by all users.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: The unique identifier of the created document

context.title: Context
context.description: The context of the guidance document, as a list of strings, that will be indexed. Each string will be vectorized separately to generate a separate record.
